knowledges.detail: Ethical guidelines, regulations and data protection rules for working on clinical trials.
Requirement for participants to provide informed consent, and how to protect their rights, safety and wellbeing throughout the trial.
Drug development processes, clinical guidelines, and variability in study design in different indications and phases of research.
Different types of study monitoring and oversight including site selection, initiation, maintenance and close out.
Investigational product processes including handling and labelling, storage and transport, blind maintenance and unblinding, and investigational product accountability.
Project management methodologies and techniques for clinical trials.
Verification requirements for source documents.
Scientific information and terminology applied when conducting clinical trials including physiology and disease, pharmacology, biochemistry, genetics and the link to personalised medicines.
The range and operational processes of bespoke digital systems used for clinical trials, including eSource, Electronic Medical Records, eConsent, data visualisation tools and emerging technologies.
Retention and archiving of clinical trial records including the document management requirements of the Trial Master File.
The ALCOA (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original and Accurate) principles for ensuring data integrity.
Methods and techniques used to capture, process, analyse, and evaluate data in clinical trials.
Statistical principles used in the analysis of quantitative and qualitative clinical trial data  as defined in the study protocol, including power, sample size and p-values
Bio-sample management including handling, labelling, storage and transport procedures, result dissemination and review.
How operational, scientific, and commercial factors interact across the development lifecycle.
Key stakeholders within the clinical trials and health and care systems landscape, their roles and relationships.
Approaches and strategies to stakeholder management.
Collaborative teamworking practices and how own role fits with, and supports, organisation strategy and objectives.
Methods and techniques used to communicate with, and present to diverse audiences, adapting communication techniques accordingly.
Own organisation’s requirement for collaboration across functions and geographies, policies and decision pathways, networks and communication channels.
Critical thinking, problem-solving, and continuous improvement principles.
Why seeking feedback on your work practices and evaluating areas for development and continuous improvement is important.
The vision and strategy, structure and governance of own organisation.

behaviours.detail: Proactive and reacts positively to emerging trends; is curious, forward-looking, open to change and looks to find ways which will enhance the trials process.
Adapts positively to challenging situations and changing work priorities and patterns, demonstrating resilience and ensuring deadlines continue to be met in critical situations.
Embraces sustainability and encourages others to achieve sustainability goals within scope of responsibility.
Acts inclusively when collaborating with internal and external team and stakeholders, embracing equity, diversity and inclusion, showing respect for others.
Take ownership of own development needs updating their knowledge and skills in relation to areas that influence their work.

skills.detail: Apply ethical and regulatory guidelines and data protection procedures in clinical trials to ensure quality standards are met.
Apply processes to protect participants’ rights in clinical trials, including report deviations.
Uphold participants rights and promote compliance and ethical practice in line with industry standards and regulatory codes of practice.
Assess and incorporate clinical trial and drug development concepts and processes in decision making and actions.
Interpret and apply scientific information and terminology, to inform decision making, optimise clinical trial execution, and communicate evidence to stakeholders.
Adhere to ALCOA principles when producing and managing documents and records including, electronic Clinical Trial Management Systems, electronic Trial Master Files, and site monitoring visit reports.
Analyse and evaluate clinical trial operational data and information to understand relevance and limitations.
Utilise information from clinical systems to ensure data quality and timeliness.
Plan, prioritise and organise work to meet deadlines.
Monitor and report on progress against plans, identify any elements requiring support or action.
Apply stakeholder management theories and techniques to build and sustain collaborative working relationships.
Coordinate, negotiate with and manage expectations of diverse stakeholders and multi-disciplinary teams with conflicting priorities, interests and timescales.
Use digital tools and technologies to improve efficiency, outcomes, and solve problems, while learning and adapting to new ways of working.
Communicate information to technical and non-technical audiences either verbally, through presentation or in written form, using supporting information when required.
Review and critique the work of others making judgements free from bias.
Evaluate and apply problem solving and continuous improvement principles within own area of responsibility.
Recognise limits of own competence and seek advice and support.
Plan and undertake development opportunities to meet compliance, organisational, and personal objectives.
Contribute to the development of others, enabling training, knowledge transfer, and peer support.
Take personal responsibility and prioritise sustainable outcomes.
Comply with equality, diversity, and inclusion policies and procedures in the workplace.

duties.dutyDetail: Contribute to the delivery of different stages of clinical trials; ensuring quality and compliance with regulations and inspection readiness.

Assist with the preparation, dissemination, and tracking of clinical trial documents and records. For example, site monitoring visit reports, site agreements, risk-based monitoring plans, risk and mitigation action logs.
Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of clinical trial data, clinical study management monitoring and reporting in line with testing requirements in a timely manner.
Take responsibility for planning, prioritising and managing work activities on clinical trial tasks or projects.
Collaborate across multiple functions, groups or stakeholders to deliver clinical trials.
Contribute to problem solving-activities in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
Develop, support, or contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Evidence continuous professional development; maintaining knowledge and skills in relation to clinical trials that influence their work, including emerging trends, innovations, technologies, tools and techniques, environmental sustainability and sustainable practices.
